input.title: Product Engineer (AI-native)
input.text: We are a 25-person startup in Prague building an AI assistant for accountants. As a Product Engineer you own features end to end: you talk to customers, decide what to build with the PM, write the code and ship it the same week. Our stack: TypeScript, React and Next.js on the frontend, Python with FastAPI on the backend, PostgreSQL, and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) with retrieval-augmented generation. You have 3+ years of full-stack experience, strong product thinking, and you write clear English. Czech is a plus. Hybrid, Prague Karlin. We offer ESOP, 5 weeks of vacation and a MultiSport card.
